title: Measuring AI Systems Beyond Accuracy
reasoning: The paper's central thesis is to move beyond simple accuracy metrics towards a more holistic evaluation framework for AI systems. It explicitly advocates for assessing systems based on their alignment with human values, stakeholder needs, and ethical principles. A significant portion of the paper is dedicated to evaluating bias, unintended consequences, and risks to human users, which constitutes a substantial evaluation of ethics in AI systems rather than a brief mention.
